:::{#thm-gauss-score}
#### Score function of a Gaussian variable

Let $X \sim \ndist{\pmean, \ss}$ with $\ss$ known.
The score of a single observation $x$ with respect to $\pmean$
is its deviation from the mean, divided by the variance:

$$\score = \frac{x - \E{X}}{\Var{X}} = \frac{x - \pmean}{\ss}$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-gauss-score-fn.

:::
